headword: {一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}
gloss: explosive situation; on the verge of eruption

definitions.gloss: explosive situation; critical state; on the verge of eruption
definitions.explanation: A tense situation that could explode into conflict or crisis at any moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Relations between the two countries are at the breaking point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The meeting had an explosive atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緊張感|きんちょうかん}→緊張感：20207_kinchoukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っていた→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: A volatile tension hung in the air between the two of them.

notes:
STRUCTURE (YOJIJUKUGO):
{一|いっ} (one) + {触|しょく} (touch) + {即|そく} (immediate) + {発|はつ} (explosion)
Literal: "one touch, immediate explosion"

USAGE:
・{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (explosive situation)
・{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (tense atmosphere)
・{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧ (imminent crisis)

CONTEXTS:
Almost always used attributively, before の plus a noun such as ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ or ⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧, rather than as a predicate on its own. Often used for international relations, workplace conflicts, personal disputes, or any situation with high tension.

SIMILAR IDIOMS:
・⟦{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}→危機一髪：06949_kikiippatsu⟧ - close call, narrow escape
・⟦{緊迫|きんぱく}した→緊迫：05918_kinpaku⟧ - tense, strained
